description: What the Boite UI needs: the core IPC, the frameless window's own controls (drag, minimize, maximize state and toggle, close), the interface zoom on its own webview (Ctrl+= and Ctrl+-, lib/zoom.ts), the drag-and-drop events, the folder picker, handing an external link to the system browser, showing a file the agent wrote in the system file manager (reveal only: nothing is opened or run), opening Boite's own keybindings file in the app the system gives JSON (the scope admits that file name only, so an agent's file cannot run through it), and listening for `browser://event`, which `core:default` already covers through `core:event:default`. This capability names the `main` window and no remote origin, so a page a browser surface loaded resolves none of it. The application commands (`core_endpoint`, `quit_shell`, `notify` and the eight `browser_*` ones) are gated by nothing here, which is why each of them refuses any caller but the `main` webview in `src/browser.rs`.
